resolvedAssertion.test: UX uses the exact Figma introduction, typography, tile wording and desktop positions
resolvedAssertion.cause: Container units serialize the nominal 50px font as 49.999992px in WebKit; exact-string assertion was too strict.
resolvedAssertion.fix: Compare numeric computed font size to the independent Figma value with three-decimal-place tolerance.

targetedRecheck.command: PORTFOLIO_TEST_TARGET=production PORTFOLIO_TEST_CROSS_BROWSER=1 npx playwright test tests/ux.spec.js --grep 'UX uses the exact Figma' --workers=2

finalCoverage.method: Full regression results with the corrected typography/geometry check reverified in all six projects. Runtime code remained unchanged between runs.

knownSkippedChecks.title: desktop image geometry matches the inspected frame, including every crop and repeated Markets image

visualReview.limitations: Browser-engine checks with emulated or phone-sized viewports; native Safari and real mobile hardware were not automated. The inline preview host was unavailable; local production browser QA and screenshots succeeded.
